packages.note: 1.4.4 character import reads the server directly

Rubberband fix: no more hard pull-backs in hunts. Falling forever fixed: a player who falls off the map is put back where they last stood. Game log on by default for reports. Middleman: re-rolling a +3 cell costs 20 Aetherdust instead of 2,000 Rams and shows the Aetherdust icon (BitSents). The game no longer offers items you have none of.

launcher.notes: Play Infinite is on the Play page now (the Forever Beta tab is gone): region and PC rating sit above the play bar, the play bar stays at the bottom and the badge shows Ready / Connecting / Playing Infinite / Connection failed. More menu lines are lettered A to R and colour coded, so support can say More, then F. 1.3.1 shows as a greyed version tab. Seasons is now Hunt Pass. Help is now Send my logs. Game Rules, Hunt Pass and Inventory pick between 1.6.2 and 1.14.7 only. New Builds tab: the 1.14.7 gear with icons, perks, cell slots and rank-3 cells, bonded weapons and weapon parts, summed perks, save and share codes, and import of reforged.dauntless-builder.com build links. A new loading screen for Infinite.
